derivativeChanges: Mesh simplification where needed; texture resizing and JPEG compression. Scene removes a modern human figure, changes lighting, places interactive teaching copies, and scales the tomb. Original model links retained. These changes do not establish archaeological accuracy. Removed 1,833 coincident opaque faces from the tomb mesh, retaining photographed surfaces to prevent flicker. Added modern teaching ramps for floor transitions. Wall textures retain original author-supplied resolution (up to 2048 pixels), recompressed for web use. Separated the combined karaman.arman souvenir display into named components, standardized their axes, and clipped the lower modern coffin supports. Coffin and Anubis shrine are independently interactive replicas; unidentified chair/vessel geometry is not placed. Pectoral is a labeled teaching copy with unverified findspot. On-demand source color detail restored to 2048–4096 pixels for all eleven interactive artifacts. Larger images reduced to 4096; opaque PNG color maps JPEG-compressed at quality 95. Original source geometry and UV correspondence retained.
